items.q: We are focused on lowering costs and making sure that there are no distractions in the statehouse from doing the work the voters have asked us to do,” Kwoka said on a press call with The Center Square. “This is housing, childcare, lowering healthcare costs, lowering energy costs, lowering property taxes.

items.t: Said the federal government shutdown was a destabilizing way to run a government, citing its effect on Seacoast shipyard workers and their families.
items.q: It’s obviously a huge economic driver on the Seacoast. These folks have families. They have kids to provide for. And so, this is a really destabilizing way to run a government.
